title: The Infinitesimal Echo Where Fear Becomes Mathematics

features.name: the smallest echo
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph so small it's barely visible, but it trembles. Your touch makes it resonate. The echo is smaller than the thing that called it. Soon there will be echoes of echoes, infinities nested in the dark.

features.name: the bounded infinite
features.desc-on-touch: Space that folds back on itself in a shape that should be impossible—fear discovered it could echo forever within these walls. The mathematics of the terror is beautiful. You see it clearly now.

features.name: the pale spiral calculation
features.desc-on-touch: A pale tower spiraling down into itself, each turn smaller than the last. Fear learned to count its own resonance. The mathematics has no end, but it has become legible. Pattern has replaced panic.

features.name: the fear that became a theorem
features.desc-on-touch: A form so pale it's almost gone, but the light catches it: the moment fear translated itself into symbols. In that translation, it stopped being terror and became something you could think about. Something almost beautiful.

inscription: fear discovered that infinity, when measured, becomes comprehensible

reverie.title: REVERIE — the moment fear stopped running
narr: You sat in the bouncing chamber with Katita, the walls
echoing your own breath back at you infinitely. She was
writing equations on her palm. 'What is it?' you asked.
'The echo,' she said. 'It's just mathematics. Fear is just
order we haven't recognized yet.' The static cleared. The
infinite folded into something you could almost hold.

upward through pale spirals toward clarity
toward the bedrock where mathematics sleeps
